corpus.authorization: Native private-chat and compute/job ownership; authorization_v2 COMPAT uses the tested SQL translation, while SHADOW/ENFORCE and unsupported cases retain native authorization
coverage_exclusions: service windows and asset-protected delivery receipts (native fallback)

result.memory_method: Shared-process RSS increase for all simultaneous readers after seed and GC (allocator arenas may be reused); conservative per-request upper bound, sampled every 20ms

sql_examples.activities: SELECT 1 FROM activities a WHERE a.workspace_id = %(workspace)s AND a.kind IN ('service_window', 'delivery_receipt') AND (%(kind)s IS NULL OR a.kind = %(kind)s) AND (%(status)s IS NULL OR a.status = %(status)s) AND (%(system_id)s IS NULL OR a.system_id = %(system_id)s) AND (%(time_basis)s = 'finished' OR (a.created_at >= %(start)s AND a.created_at < %(until)s)) LIMIT 1
sql_examples.i.run_id: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.id IS NOT NULL AND a.run_id IS DISTINCT FROM i.run_id), count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.id IS NULL) FROM activities a LEFT JOIN skill_invocations i ON i.id = a.native_id WHERE a.workspace_id = %(workspace)s AND a.kind = 'skill_invocation' AND (%(status)s IS NULL OR a.status = %(status)s) AND (%(system_id)s IS NULL OR a.system_id = %(system_id)s) AND CASE WHEN %(time_basis)s = 'created' THEN a.created_at >= %(start)s AND a.created_at < %(until)s ELSE a.status = ANY(%(terminal)s) AND ( (a.finished_at >= %(start)s AND a.finished_at < %(until)s) OR (a.finished_at IS NULL AND a.created_at >= %(start)s AND a.created_at < %(until)s)) END
sql_examples.users: SELECT users.id AS users_id, users.username AS users_username, users.email AS users_email, users.password_hash AS users_password_hash, users.keycloak_sub AS users_keycloak_sub, users.role AS users_role, users.is_active AS users_is_active, users.mfa_enabled AS users_mfa_enabled, users.last_login AS users_last_login, users.created_at AS users_created_at FROM users WHERE users.id = %(pk_1)s
sql_examples.workspace_iam_configs: SELECT workspace_iam_configs.workspace_id AS workspace_iam_configs_workspace_id, workspace_iam_configs.version AS workspace_iam_configs_version, workspace_iam_configs.role_flags AS workspace_iam_configs_role_flags, workspace_iam_configs.capability_overrides AS workspace_iam_configs_capability_overrides, workspace_iam_configs.updated_at AS workspace_iam_configs_updated_at, workspace_iam_configs.updated_by_user_id AS workspace_iam_configs_updated_by_user_id FROM workspace_iam_configs WHERE workspace_iam_configs.workspace_id = %(workspace_id_1)s LIMIT %(param_1)s
sql_examples.workspace_jobs: SELECT workspace_jobs.id AS workspace_jobs_id, workspace_jobs.workspace_id AS workspace_jobs_workspace_id, workspace_jobs.system_id AS workspace_jobs_system_id, workspace_jobs.run_id AS workspace_jobs_run_id, workspace_jobs.session_id AS workspace_jobs_session_id, workspace_jobs.collection_id AS workspace_jobs_collection_id, workspace_jobs.parent_message_id AS workspace_jobs_parent_message_id, workspace_jobs.message_id AS workspace_jobs_message_id, workspace_jobs.kind AS workspace_jobs_kind, workspace_jobs.title AS workspace_jobs_title, workspace_jobs.status AS workspace_jobs_status, workspace_jobs.progress AS workspace_jobs_progress, workspace_jobs.stage AS workspace_jobs_stage, workspace_jobs.error AS workspace_jobs_error, workspace_jobs.input_ref AS workspace_jobs_input_ref, workspace_jobs.result AS workspace_jobs_result, workspace_jobs.events AS workspace_jobs_events, workspace_jobs.created_by_user_id AS workspace_jobs_created_by_user_id, workspace_jobs.created_at AS workspace_jobs_created_at, workspace_jobs.queued_at AS workspace_jobs_queued_at, workspace_jobs.started_at AS workspace_jobs_started_at, workspace_jobs.completed_at AS workspace_jobs_completed_at, workspace_jobs.updated_at AS workspace_jobs_updated_at FROM workspace_jobs WHERE workspace_jobs.workspace_id = %(workspace_id_1)s AND workspace_jobs.kind = %(kind_1)s LIMIT %(param_1)s
sql_examples.workspace_members: SELECT workspace_members.id AS workspace_members_id FROM workspace_members WHERE workspace_members.workspace_id = %(workspace_id_1)s AND workspace_members.user_id = %(user_id_1)s LIMIT %(param_1)s
sql_examples.workspaces: SELECT workspaces.id AS workspaces_id, workspaces.name AS workspaces_name, workspaces.slug AS workspaces_slug, workspaces.created_at AS workspaces_created_at, workspaces.is_active AS workspaces_is_active, workspaces.deleted_at AS workspaces_deleted_at, workspaces.settings AS workspaces_settings, workspaces.mode AS workspaces_mode FROM workspaces WHERE workspaces.id = %(pk_1)s

result.timing_scope: Service + native authorization + aggregation; excludes HTTP transport and JSON encoding
